translation.name: YAUBADA BONANA VEYAO IVAGUNA Bona Iduna

book.name: LOMA
book.title: Folo yana leta LOMA tovetumagana agaidiya

content: Yaubada miIsileli adi tufo gihinekalikaliyedi.

Tu hida miIsileli yadi tagakulu faꞋina ahe gagahe. Gavaiyami? KaꞋi Yaubada Tauna yana yoꞋo higa miIsileli gikilowedi? Keke, keke-moꞋa! Iya tauku kwanaIsileli, iya Abelahamo bwanenena ada Abelahamo gaisena Beniyamina ana yoꞋo agaidiya gatubuyemu, ada iya keke gidakiloweku.

E, Yaubada yana yoꞋo tuwai-lokalokana givenuwadadane-vagahidi amanadi keke gidakilowedi. Yaubada bonana ana toꞋawatalatalaina ana egana Elaiya kahihina Veyao Tuwaina ana bukiya gidadauda-ma maꞋi wahalamanena o kaꞋi keke? Buki ana bai saꞋeyana againe Elaiya miIsileli gihawavekoyoyedi Yaubada matane.
Elaiya gigahe-kawowo gigayo,

content.text: Kaiwabu, O bona ana toꞋawatalatalaina moyaꞋaidi
Iya au akukaibe-moꞋa ada nuwanuwadi hinaluveꞋalikaku.

content: Gavaimi bonalaufata Yaubada bana givele? Yaubada gigahena gigayo,

content.text: Gavadi-yo hidedemi ugahe? Iya yaku kaliva seveni tausani (7,000) Tauku faꞋikuya gasevehailedi, higa badi keke yaubada kilumina ana egana Beli againe hidaꞋoduꞋodu-ma kalivai-dina.

content: Meda anafaiweya tova adamoya miIsileli tufoidiga Yaubada yana nuwadoga faꞋina giluwafadi be yana kaliva himimiyami.

Yaubada keke kaliva yadi huluva yamumuna faꞋina gidaluwafadi, au Tauna yana nuwadogeya giluwafadi. KaꞋi Yaubada kaliva yadi huluva yamumuna gidaꞋitaluveluveni-yo gidaluwafadi digo, yana nuwadoga vaita dewa yamumuna fatana au keke nuwadoga velemoꞋena.

Yaubada yana lauwafa gavaiyami ana nuwanuwa? MiIsileli yadi yegayega Yaubada matane hilelelena tu keke moyaꞋaidi hidanuhagani. Au tufoidiga Yaubada giluwafadi-ma kalivai-dina hinuhagana. Tu velugadiyao tagadi gikulu-moꞋa.
Meda anafaiweya yadi tagakulu faꞋina Veyao Tuwaina ana buki gigahe gigayo,

content.text: Boi hidedemi hivebutu be giꞋela tova adamoya.

content: Kadu Devida Yaubada nibaineyao giꞋalatabutabuyedi ada yana gahe Veyao Tuwaina ana bukiya gidadauda gigayo,
Au hidedemi Devida gigahe.
YoꞋo tulidiyao kalivai-dina Yaubada yana kibababala
hinuhagana.

KaduꞋe ganatoliluvaluva. Badi miIsileli Yesu Keliso hikilowena faꞋina, Yaubada yana eda againe hitutumadumadu be hibeꞋu. KaꞋi yadi beꞋu againe agolaufofola hivaina o kaꞋi keke? Keke, keke-moꞋa! Badi miIsileli hikoyo faꞋina, Yaubada yoꞋo tulidiyao kalivai-dina agaidiya ginuwanuwa be ginakibababaledi, higa vaita miIsileli hinaꞋita-yo hinaꞋahukwahukwa-yo adi kibababala Yesu Keliso againe hinalelena.

Badi miIsileli hikoyo be Keliso hikilowena faꞋina, fafali moyaꞋaina kalivai-dina Yaubada yana nuwakabubu lakahina hinuhagana. Yaubada yana nuwakabubu badi miIsileli hinuhagababuna faꞋina, badi keke miYuda tu yoꞋo tulidiyao kalivai-dina Yaubada yana lokolokofou moyaꞋaina hinuhagadi. KaꞋi miIsileli yadi kilowa faꞋina mali yoꞋo Yaubada yana lokolokofou hinuhagadi, au aimo miIsileli moyaꞋaidi Yaubada againe hinahagaviladi ana toveya, ide Yaubada yana kaliva moyaꞋaida yana lokolokofou kananuhagadi-ma gavatubuga kadu gavavewaga!

Tu omi Loma againe wamimiyami-ma tufoimi keke miYuda tu yoꞋo tulimiyao kalivai-mina. Adamoya omi agaimiya ganagahe be wananogalina. Yesu Keliso givegideku be Bana loseyanina omi yoꞋo tulimiyao kalivai-mina agaimiya giꞋiveniniseku. Mena yaku faisewa gaꞋivelakahina be higa tauku yaku yoꞋo kalivai-dina omi ami kibababala ana nauhaga faꞋina hinaꞋahukwahukwa-yo tufoidi Yesu Keliso againe hinahagaviladi-yo kadu adi kibababala buye hinanuhagana.

Wananuwanuwa Yaubada miIsileli gikilowedi againe fafali moyaꞋaina kalivai-dina Yaubada buye hiveyao. Aimo tova mulina miIsileli hinahagaviladi be Yaubada yana yoꞋogaga agaidiya ginavegaꞋauledi againe, yadi miya gavayamumu! Au makewaꞋe yadi yewa vaita alikeya hinamididi-havagi be wayawaidi ivaguna hinamiyami.

WaꞋita, kaꞋi yami faha waꞋaiyala be bavagu Yaubada againe wahawahegena, au vaita yami faha matatabuna Yaubada againe wadahawahegeni be Bana gidagayo, “Hida hima yaku faha.” Meda kaꞋi yami ai saꞋeyana walamina faꞋina wanagahe wanagayo, “Medema Yaubada yana gaitoma,” au vaita dobona kadu laganina higa ai matatabuna Yaubada againe wadahawahegeni be Bana gidagayo, “Hida hima yaku ai.” Meda anafaiweya tuwai-moꞋena miIsileli bwanenediyao kikaiwabudiyao faꞋidiya Yaubada gigahe gigayo, “Hida hima yaku kaliva,” faꞋina tova mulina bwanenediyao moyaꞋaidi faꞋidiya ginagahe ginagayo, “Hida hima yaku yoꞋo.”
Abaluvefota ma ai olive luhei, saꞋeyana melamelala saꞋeyana walawalaꞋa.

Kadu abaluvefota saꞋeyana ma miIsileli vaita ai melamelala ana egana olive amine, tu omi yoꞋo tulimiyao kalivai-mina vaita olive walawalaꞋa amine. Yaubada mena ai melamelala laganina tufoidi giludobodi be gisedi, tu ai walawalaꞋa laganina tufoidi gikuyadi digo giꞋaliyedi be ai melamelala dobone gihavidi ada uyona givedamana be hitubulatuna. Ai walawalaꞋa laganina ai melamelala uyona hiyuyuna be hififaiwala amine, meda Yaubada yana nuwadoga tulina tulina miIsileli giveledi-ma agaidiya omi yami faiwala wavaivaina.

Badi miIsileli vaita ai laganina Yaubada giludobodi-ma keke wanaꞋitatagotagodi. Wanogali! Ai laganina keke walamina gidaveꞋani, au walamina laganina giveꞋadi. Omi ai walawalaꞋa laganina miIsileli walamidiya yami faiwala wavaivaina faꞋina, keke-moꞋa gidalubodami be wanaꞋitatagotagodi.
Atu omi wadagahe wadagayo, “Ika tu Yaubada miIsileli giludobohegedi be yadi abaga ime faꞋimeya gisiunana.”

Wagahe velemodi atu badi keke hidavetumagana faꞋina Yaubada giludobohegedi tu omi yami wavetumagana faꞋina wamimiyami. Keke wananuwanuwalaka, au taumiyao wanaꞋitaveꞋavimi be yami vetumagana keke wanahegeni.
MiIsileli vaita ai melamelala lagani-moꞋena ma hikoyo againe, Yaubada keke gidayavadi. KaꞋi omi vaita ai walawalaꞋa laganina gihavimi-ma wanakoyo digo, keke-moꞋa omi ginayavami.

FaꞋina Yaubada yana nuwakabubu kadu yana nuwakoyo wananuwenuwena. Badi hibeꞋu-ma agaidiya gilaufata tu omi ginuwakabubuyemi. KaꞋi omi yami wavetumaganadona wanamiyami amine o ginanuwakabubuyemi. Keke digo, kadu omi ginaludobohegemi.
Ada kaꞋi miIsileli hinahagaviladi-yo hinavetumagana amine o, Yaubada yana yoꞋogaga agaidiya ginaseyewedi, faꞋina adi seyewa Bana ana tagalowalowa.

Ada au omi yoꞋo tulimiyao kalivai-mina vaita ai walawalaꞋa laganina Yaubada gikuyadi be ai melamelala againe gihavidi-yo hivetubulatuna-ma amine. Ai walawalaꞋa laganina keke ihayana ai melamelala againe hinavetubulatuni. Tu badi miIsileli vaita ai melamelala laganina Yaubada giludobodi-ma au Yaubada ihayana taudiyao yadi ai againe ginahaviyewedi, faꞋina medema lagani-moꞋena.
Yaubada yana vevai miIsileli adi yoꞋo faꞋidiya.

Tu tobohiyakweyao, nuwanuwaku Yaubada yana vevai boi gisevauyena tu tova adamoya gihawavemogatalena-ma wanahalamanena, be higa keke wananuwanuwalaka vaita omi yoꞋo tulimiyao kalivai-mina badi miIsileli wadakaiwabuhegedi. Yaubada yana vevai sevasevauyana hidede amine. MiIsileli keke matatabudi hidatagakulu. Au tufoidi Yesu Keliso hivetumaganena. Tu badi hitagakulu-ma yadi tagakulu hinanunauwena tu omi yoꞋo tulimiyao kalivai-mina ami gavaiyehi tuwai-lokalokana Yaubada giluwafami-ma ami kilagalaga amine yana yoꞋogaga agaidiya wanaluku-Ꞌowoga yo badi tagadi ginaꞋafolena.
Ada au medema tovai-nadi miIsileli adi yoꞋo matatabudi hinaluku-Ꞌowoga be adi kibababala hinanuhagana. Au hidedemi Yaubada yana vevai. Meda tuwaina Yaubada Veyao Tuwaina ana bukiya gigayo,

content.text: be hidedemi yaku veyao agaidiya ganasena.

content: Hidedemi Yaubada gigahe miIsileli faꞋidiya.

Tuwai-moꞋena Yaubada miIsileli bwanenediyao kikaiwabudiyao giluwafadi be gigahedi vaita badiꞋiyao kadu bwanenediyao buye ginanuwakabubuyedi. Ma badi miIsileli Yesu Keliso ana VenuwaꞋata Yamumuna hikilowena faꞋina, badi au Yaubada nibaineyao. Ma yadi kilowa againe omi yoꞋo tulimiyao kalivai-mina ami kibababala ana eda giꞋayauna. Atu tuwai-moꞋena Yaubada miIsileli bwanenediyao kikaiwabudiyao giluwafadi faꞋina, Bana aimo ginuwanuwa lakahina miIsileli agaidiya. Yaubada yana lauwafa kadu yana nuwakabubu keke-moꞋa ginavaiyeweni.
Tuwaina omi yoꞋo tulimiyao kalivai-mina Yaubada wadibutoyogena tu tova adamoya badi miIsileli Yaubada hidibutoyogena faꞋina yami eda giꞋayauna be Yaubada yana hinekalikali wanuhagana.

Meda anafaiweya omi yoꞋo tulimiyao kalivai-mina Yaubada yana hinekalikali wanuhagana faꞋina, tova adamoya badi miIsileli Yaubada hidibutoyogena higa vaita aimo badi omi buye Yaubada yana hinekalikali hinanuhagana.
FaꞋina Yaubada kaliva moyaꞋaida yada idibutoyoga faꞋina giseda yogoyogonideyao be higa moyaꞋaida ginahinekalikaliyeda.
Yaubada ana hawadavadava.

Yaubada yana nuwadoga gavadawana! Yana nuwahuya kadu yana halamana gavatubuga! HakwaꞋadi yana nuwanuwa inubana anafaiweya ginahalamaneni? Au keke, keke tamo. HakwaꞋadi yana faisewa tavagina anafaiweya ginaꞋuyeni? Au keke, keke tamo.
Meda Veyao Tuwaina ana buki gigahe gigayo,

FaꞋina gaitoma moyaꞋaidi Bana againe hiveꞋinuba ada Bana yana faiwala againe givefota-vagahidi ada Bana yana kaiwabu faꞋina himimiyami. Yaubada ana egana kanakilakahina be yana kaiwabu ginaduva-vagata tova inaga inaga keke ana abalauyabu. Ehe hidedemi.
